tbesh_html:
1) to practice divination, divine, observe signs, learn by experience, diligently observe, practice fortunetelling, take as an omen
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to practice divination
1a2) to observe the signs or omens

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) [idiom] enchantment, learn by experience, [idiom] indeed, diligently observe.
